latest.title: The geometric convergence of a parallel domain decomposition method on manifolds
latest.abstract: This paper establishes a convergence theory for a continuous domain decomposition method for elliptic equations on manifolds. This method originated in \cite{lions2} in the setting of Euclidean domains and was later adapted and generalized to manifolds by \cite{qin_wang_wang}. Although its convergence was known, whether the convergence is geometric has remained open. We prove its geometric convergence and provide various estimates on the convergence rate.
latest.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
latest.workSummary: 证明流形上连续并行区域分解椭圆求解法以几何速度收敛，并估计收敛率。
latest.breakthrough: 将已知收敛提升为定量几何收敛。
latest.limitations: 连续算法的结果不能直接当作任意网格离散实现的复杂度保证。 当前为摘要级分析，技术细节与结论须回查原文。
latest.priorityReason: 可为几何 PDE 数值方法提供依据，理论突破集中在收敛率。
